title: Receipts/DuplicateKeyDiagnosticReceiptTests.cs: edge-case test passes on head (1 tests): no defect shown; refutes 1 lens claim(s): logic-edge-2

refutes.claim: The new `if (!intMembers.ContainsKey(...))` and `if (!stringMembers.ContainsKey(...))` guards silently drop the second member that shares a key with an earlier one. No diagnostic is reported for it. Before the change the duplicate made the collector throw, which was a loud failure. Now a [MessagePackObject] with two [Key(0)] members gets no analyzer error, and the generated formatter omits the second member, so its data is silently never serialized. The dynamic resolver used under SuppressSourceGeneration = true rejects duplicate keys at run time, yet the analyzer stays silent, which runs against the requirement that the analyzer report violations.
